description: This file defines interfaces and data structures for virtual input devices, including key, mouse, and touch input types, within the WPEFramework project. It includes enum definitions, data structures for input events, and message types for IPC communication.

classes.name: LinkInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a virtual input link, including mode and name.

classes.name: KeyData
classes.description: Contains data for key input events, including action type and key code.

classes.name: MouseData
classes.description: Contains data for mouse input events, including action, button, and movement deltas.

classes.name: TouchData
classes.description: Contains data for touch input events, including action, index, and coordinates.
